entries.caption: Keeper, you hear me? Storm's right on top of you. Keep that light burning till dawn. Lose the light, or let the water take the tower, and we're all done for.
Fix tonight's jobs. Sleep upstairs when they're done.
Three nights. Keep the light burning and the water down. Bring every ship home.
There's a pipe giving out downstairs. Grab the wrench off the bench.
Hold grip to take the wrench. Bring its head to the bolt, then pull toward you.
Hold grip. Bring it to the bolt and pull toward you. Push back, pull again.
Leave the wrench, keeper. Follow the lamps to your next job.
We saw your light last night. Another front's coming in. Generator's down again.
Generator's dead. Read the plate on the side. Prime it, choke it, pull.
Fuel's running low. Line up the lantern and send the storm warning.
Still with us, keeper? Check the board. It's going to be a long one.
The pipe needs you. Take the wrench downstairs.
Next, the generator. Follow the lamps upstairs.
Head to the radio. Send the storm warning.
Up to the lantern, keeper. Light it and line up the marks.
Check the breakers beside the generator.
Jobs done. Grip your bunk upstairs.
Follow the hiss, keeper. Wrench on the bolt. Pull.
The plate on the generator. Fuel, prime three, choke, pull three, choke down.
Check the breakers. You can't run everything at once.
Get up to the lantern. Light it, then turn the wheel till the marks line up.
Four steps on the radio. Power, tune, code, then hold the mic.
Work's done. Bunk's on the third floor.
Not yet. There's still work to do.
That'll do it.
There she goes.
Light's burning.
That'll hold. Get to your bunk, keeper. You'll need it.
We see your light, keeper. Every ship made it through. Get some rest.

Pipe's gone again, keeper. Get the wrench on it before the water climbs.
Power's back. Now get that lantern lined up and send the storm warning.
Set the wrench down, keeper. You won't need it up there.
Take a breath, keeper. The storm's waiting on you, but not for long.
Tonight it's the pipe and the generator. Pipe first.
Tonight it's everything, keeper. Pipe, power, lantern and the radio.
One of you hold that valve. The other, get on the bolt.
Set the clamp on the valve, then work the bolt.
Grab a handset off the bench. You'll hear each other across the floors.
